{'text': '運動追蹤平台 Strava 今日宣布擴展其力量訓練功能，新增由教練設計的引導式訓練課程，並支援即時組數與次數追蹤。以下是詳細內容。', 'paragraph_context': 'Exercise-tracking platform Strava announced today a new expansion of its strength training features, adding coach-designed guided workouts with live set and rep tracking. Here are the details.'}

{'text': 'Strava 擴展力量訓練功能', 'paragraph_context': 'Strava expands strength training features'}

{'text': '數月前，Strava 宣布全面改革其力量訓練體驗，包括專屬的訓練記錄功能以追蹤組數、次數及重量，還有自動肌肉地圖等功能。', 'paragraph_context': 'A few months ago, Strava announced an overhaul of its strength training experience, with a dedicated workout log for tracking sets, reps, and weights, automatic muscle maps, and more.'}

{'text': '今日，該公司公布了在此基礎上建立的新功能，包括由教練設計的力量訓練課程，透過動畫示範、動作技巧提示及針對肌群的資訊，引導用戶完成每項動作。', 'paragraph_context': 'Today, the company unveiled new features that build on that, including coach-designed strength workouts that guide users through each exercise with animations, form tips, and information on the targeted muscle groups.'}

{'text': '用戶現在可以即時記錄自己的組數和次數，訓練結束後，結果會自動儲存至活動紀錄。今年較早前推出的肌肉地圖亦會更新，以反映已完成的動作。', 'paragraph_context': 'Now, users can track their sets and reps as they go, with the results automatically saved to their activity once the session ends. The muscle maps introduced earlier this year will also update to reflect the completed exercises.'}

{'text': 'Strava 表示：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s Strava:'}

{'text': '新功能將於未來數星期內陸續向訂閱用戶推出，並提供一個免費試用課程供免費用戶體驗。這項新體驗透過引導式動畫，帶領運動員完成由資深力量訓練教練設計的課程，讓他們能即時記錄組數和次數。點擊每個動作亦可查看正確姿勢的指引、貼士及所針對的精確肌群。訓練結束後，每個動作、組數及次數均會直接儲存至運動員的活動紀錄，其肌肉地圖亦會更新，顯示訓練所針對的部位。', 'paragraph_context': 'Rolling out to subscribers over the next few weeks, with a sample workout available to free users, the new experience walks athletes through workouts developed by experienced strength coaches with guided animations, and lets them track sets and reps live as they go. Clicking into each exercise also provides guidance on the correct form, tips and the exact muscles targeted. When a workout ends, every exercise, set, and rep is saved directly to the athlete’s activity, and their muscle map updates to show where the effort went.'}

{'text': '該公司表示，今次的更新亦新增了引導式跑步訓練課程，並計劃在今年底前推出更多訓練系列。', 'paragraph_context': 'The company said today’s update also introduces new guided running workouts, with additional workout series planned before the end of the year.'}

{'text': '談到未來發展，Strava 表示正在研發一項新功能，讓用戶只需上載訓練計劃或包含組數和次數的筆記截圖，即可匯入力量訓練課程，並將加入「自建訓練課程功能」。', 'paragraph_context': 'And speaking of what’s coming, Strava says it’s working on a feature that will let users import strength workouts simply by uploading screenshots of training plans or notes containing sets and reps, “as well as a build-your-own workout feature.”'}
